entities.summary: Pete Lau (b. 1975-05-05, Hanchuan City) was a legal scholar or jurist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hanchuan City and China. Known in the fields of china, heads of state & government, asia.
